## Description

Notifications tab: which events send messages (booking confirmation, 24 h reminder, 2 h reminder, cancellation), channels enabled (email, SMS; WhatsApp placeholder for P4), sender name, quiet hours, template preview (no clinical details). Data tab: tenant country and residency (read-only), export placeholder (P5), retention defaults (read-only labels), link to access log (F-12).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Turning off a reminder type stops future scheduling of that reminder (already-queued ones are cancelled).
- [ ] **AC2.** Template previews show placeholders only; templates cannot include clinical fields (validation rejects clinical merge fields).
- [ ] **AC3.** Quiet hours prevent SMS sending inside the window (job reschedules to the window end).
- [ ] **AC4.** Residency and country are displayed read-only with the trust-centre wording.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
